card.name: Partway through split words and numbers
card.fires_on: The pole responds at the break inside a word or number that the text splits into pieces, such as thrombocytopenia, pneumonitis, a drug name or a section number like 12.4. It also fires on a hyphen in a phrase like catch-22.

modes.description: The marked piece is an early or middle part of a long medical word or brand name.
